chats.answer:
The key spec is USB Power Delivery with PPS capable of 20 V at 3 A on one USB-C port. A charger’s advertised 65 W, 100 W, or even higher rating is not enough if its PPS output cannot reach that profile. The Galaxy S26 Ultra uses this profile for Samsung’s Super Fast Charging 3.0 mode. 
Samsung au
+1

The confirmed, straightforward choice is:

Samsung - 60W Power Adapter - Black

$30.77

Best Buy

Model EP-T6010. Samsung explicitly specifies PPS 5–20 V at 3 A and S26 Ultra Super Fast Charging 3.0 compatibility. Your phone’s included USB-C cable is sufficient. 
Samsung au
+1

Third-party chargers can also deliver the phone’s fastest charging mode. GSMArena tested a 67 W third-party USB-PD charger with the required PPS profile and got a 45-minute full charge, versus 43 minutes with Samsung’s adapter. However, the review did not identify that charger’s model, and I couldn’t verify a specific third-party retail model to the same standard, so I’m not labeling one as confirmed. 
display, battery life, charging speed, speakers

When checking an alternative, look for a line such as PPS: 3.3–21 V ⎓ 3 A in the specifications for the port you’ll use. A fixed 20 V ⎓ 3 A output does not establish PPS support. For example, the Samsung 65W Trio Power Adapter cannot provide 60 W in PPS mode despite its 65 W headline rating. 
SamMobile

One qualification: I’ve interpreted “full 60 W” as supporting the phone’s maximum charging mode, not drawing exactly 60 W continuously. Independent tests measured roughly 51–53 W with the official adapter; power falls as the battery fills or warms up. 
ChargerLAB
+1

chats.answer:
The surest choice is Samsung’s 60W Power Adapter, model EP-T6010. For a third-party charger, the crucial spec is not its advertised wattage: its USB-C port must support USB Power Delivery PPS at 20V and 3A. That is the profile the Galaxy S26 Ultra uses for its 60W Super Fast Charging 3.0 mode. A charger that offers 20V/3A only under fixed PD output, or PPS only up to 11V, is not an equivalent. 
Samsung au
+1

Samsung - 60W Power Adapter - Black

$30.77

Best Buy

EP-T6010: explicitly rated by Samsung for the S26 Ultra’s 60W mode, with PPS 5–20V at 3A. Adapter only; use the cable supplied with your phone. 
Samsung Canada
+1

For other chargers, check the output label for a line such as PPS: 3.3–21V ⎓ 3A (or higher current at 20V), and make sure that profile is available on one port. On multiport chargers, connecting a second device can reduce the available power. The phone’s included 3A USB-C cable is sufficient; you do not need to buy a 5A cable for this mode. 
iTechGuides
+1

One counterexample worth avoiding is the Samsung - Super Fast Charging 65W Trio Adapter - Black: despite its 65W rating, it cannot supply the required 60W PPS profile to the Ultra. 
SamMobile

Important qualification: I’m treating “full 60W” as supporting the phone’s fastest charging mode, not promising a measured, sustained 60W draw. Independent testing measured roughly 51–53W even with Samsung’s official adapter. I could verify that a third-party 67W PPS charger matched its charging times, but the review did not identify that charger’s model, so I’m not presenting an unverified third-party shortlist as confirmed.
